title: Averaging Principle for Ordinary Differential Equations in a Multiscale Random Environment
summary: We study slow-fast stochastic systems in which a fast process, evolving within several ergodic components, drives the transition rates of a slow jump process switching between these components. Considering a differential equation whose vector field depends on both processes, we show that, under suitable ergodicity and regularity conditions, its solutions converge in law in $D([0,T],\mathbb R^d)$ to an averaged system depending only on the slow process. The averaged drift is obtained by averaging the original vector field over the invariant measure of the fast process within each component.…
